text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Osaka Hai, Satono 
Diamond prepared in a calm and composed 
manner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, when she faced Kitasan Black in 
the paddock, she caught her breath. The 
aura she gave off was completely different 
from before...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond flinched for a moment at 
Kitasan Black's sheer intensity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if to spur herself on, she repeatedly 
told herself she wouldn't lose, firing up 
her resolve once more.
